name: Beehive House
summary: Beehive House is a Bucks house from the July 2026 Pollinator Season update, themed around Queen Bee's hive. It costs 5,450 Bucks in the house shop.
description:
The Beehive House arrived in July 2026 with the Pollinator Season update. You buy it in the in-game house shop for 5,450 Bucks. It came out on the same day as the free Bee Pass, but it is not a Bee Pass reward and it is not tied to the pass.

The theme is Queen Bee's hive. One listing gives the house three floors. The Bee Pass has honey-themed furniture rewards across its 13 levels, but those are not sold as a house set. No furniture set made just for this house has been found.
tradingNotes: No special trading rules are listed for this house. Current availability should be checked in game.

name: Biodome Home
summary: Biodome Home is a retired Adopt Me house from July 2022 with a sealed dome, plants and a pond inside. It was removed in 2024 and is trade-only now.
description:
Biodome Home was released on July 28, 2022. Back then you bought it in the house shop for 2,750 Bucks. It was removed on June 10, 2024, so the shop no longer sells it. Today the only way to get one is from another player. The house is now retired. It first came out in 2022.

The outside has a sealed, dome-style look. Inside you find green plant life and a small pond. A wooden house sits in the interior. The house has two floors. It has five rooms, plus a balcony.
tradingNotes: It is no longer sold and can only be obtained by trading with another player.

name: Bunker House
summary: Bunker House is a one-story gray Adopt Me house with seven rooms and a long hallway. It was released in January 2023 and costs 750 Bucks.
description:
Released on January 26, 2023, the Bunker House came out alongside the Toxic Barrel. You buy it with 750 Bucks in the house shop. The exact name of that update is not confirmed. It is listed as a Bucks purchase with no retirement noted.

From the street it is gray, with darker gray edges. The door is light gray with a large frame, and there is one glowing yellow window. Inside, a long hallway with doors on it ends at two large fans. The house has just one story. It has seven rooms in total.
tradingNotes: It can also be obtained through trading. No other trading rules are listed, and current availability should be checked in game.

name: Castle
summary: The Castle is a three-floor Adopt Me house with two tall towers and a secret room. Buy it for 1,499 Bucks through the Change Home menu.
description:
You can buy the Castle for 1,499 Bucks through the Change Home menu. A release date has not been found. It is listed as available to buy, and no removal has been noted.

Two tall towers stand out front, with small yellow windows, and a large tree grows outside. The tower tops and banners can be recolored. Inside there are three floors and nine small rooms. Each floor has a main room, a small bedroom and a bathroom. One floor hides a secret room, which you reach by gliding through a wall corner.
tradingNotes: The Castle is still listed as a Bucks purchase, so you can also get it from the shop instead of trading for it.

name: Celebrity Mansion
summary: Celebrity Mansion is an Adopt Me house with a modern balcony and a pool with a secret room. It is no longer sold and can only be traded for.
description:
The Celebrity Mansion came from a Robux gamepass that also included an SUV vehicle. It was part of Adopt Me's final-chance Robux sale on April 24, 2026 and is no longer sold. You can only get it by trading with another player. A release date has not been found.

Outside, you will see trees and plants and a modern balcony. There is also a pool, and the pool has a secret room. The wall of that secret room is covered in Adopt Me posters. Reports disagree on how many floors the house has, so it is best to look for yourself in game.
tradingNotes: It was bought with Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it by trading.

name: Christmas Pudding House
summary: Christmas Pudding House was a free Winter Event 2025 reward for 15 pet needs. It left the game in January 2026 and is trade-only now.
description:
The Christmas Pudding House was a free reward in the Winter Event in December 2025. You earned it by completing 15 pet needs. The house left the game on January 5, 2026, when the event ended. It is no longer sold and can only be obtained by trading with another player.

The house is a mound with white icing, holly, a chimney and a wreath on the door. Its color can be customized. It has two floors. Downstairs are the main room, a kitchen and a bathroom. Upstairs are a hallway, two bedrooms and a second bathroom. Candy canes, lights and other decorations unlocked at higher pet need totals.
tradingNotes: It was tradable from January 13, 2026. The quests restarted during the event, so players could earn more than one copy.

name: Container Home
summary: Container Home is a three-story Adopt Me house with solar panels and two balconies. It was added on April 2, 2021 and costs 1,800 Bucks.
description:
Container Home was added on April 2, 2021. To get it, open the Mailbox, pick Change Home, then Add New. It costs 1,800 Bucks. It is listed as available to buy, and no removal has been noted. It is bought with Bucks, not Robux.

There are two solar panels outside, silver-framed windows and two brown-railed balconies. The upper balcony has trees. You can change the exterior color. Inside are three stories, five spacious rooms with high ceilings, and three staircases. Every room comes with default furniture, and no separate furniture set has been found.
tradingNotes: It is still bought with Bucks, so the shop is another way to get it besides trading.

name: Cozy Cabin
summary: Cozy Cabin is a two-story Adopt Me house that came with a snowmobile gamepass in January 2022. It was removed in June 2024 and is trade-only now.
description:
The Cozy Cabin was sold as the Cozy Cabin and Snowmobile gamepass, which also gave you the Snowmobile, a legendary vehicle. It was listed as released on January 6, 2022. Sales stopped on June 9, 2024. Since then it can only be obtained by trading with another player.

It is a brown cabin with a curved roof. Snow covers the bushes and trees around it. Two curved windows glow, and a small brown arch sits over the door. The chimney always has smoke rising from it. The house has two stories. The gamepass bundled it with the Snowmobile.
tradingNotes: It was a Robux purchase, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it by trading. It is no longer sold.

name: Crooked House
summary: Crooked House is a two-story Adopt Me house with a blue curved roof and a picket fence. It came with the Artsy update and costs 2,000 Bucks.
description:
The Crooked House was added in the Artsy furniture update on July 8, 2021. You buy it with 2,000 Bucks in the house shop. Nothing says it was ever retired, though current availability is worth checking in game.

The big curved roof is blue, with a smaller roof above the upper area. A large black chimney rises from it. Gray stones sit around the door and the base. A white picket fence closes in a yard with two tall green trees. The windows glow yellow, and the house leans slightly to the right. It has two stories. Changing its color only changes the roof.
tradingNotes: It can also be obtained through trading. No other trading rules are listed.

name: Donut Shop
summary: Donut Shop is an Adopt Me house with a big donut on the roof. It costs 1,299 Bucks through the Change Home menu, and you can recolor the icing.
description:
You can buy the Donut Shop with 1,299 Bucks through the Change Home menu. A release date has not been found. It is listed as available to buy, and no removal has been noted.

A large donut sits on the roof, held up by columns. There are two yellow windows and trees around the house. You can customize the icing color, the roof stripes, the walls and the floor. Inside, three rooms are linked by a small hallway. The house comes furnished by default, and no separate furniture set has been found.
tradingNotes: It is a Bucks house that is still listed as buyable, so the shop is another way to get it besides trading.

name: Dragon's Castle
summary: Dragon's Castle is a two-floor Adopt Me house shaped like a castle with a windmill and a rooftop dragon. It costs 3,000 Bucks.
description:
Dragon's Castle costs 3,000 Bucks and is bought through the Change Home menu. A release date has not been found. It is listed as available to buy, and no removal has been noted. It is a Bucks house, not a Robux one.

The house is shaped like a castle, with a windmill attached to it. A dragon structure sits on the roof, and its head follows the player. A door leads out to a balcony. Inside there are two floors and four rooms in total. No furniture set for this house has been found.
tradingNotes: It is still listed as a Bucks purchase, so you can get it from the shop instead of trading for it.

name: Eco Natural Earth House
summary: Eco Natural Earth House is a retired Adopt Me premium house from the September 2021 Eco update. It left the shop in June 2024 and is trade-only.
description:
The Eco Natural Earth House came out in September 2021 with the Eco update. It was a premium house, bought with Robux from the in-game shop, where it sat on a purple cart. It was removed from sale on June 13, 2024.

It has three floors. Details about the outside and the furniture have not been confirmed, so none are listed here. Prices reported for it differ, so no price is given either.
tradingNotes: It is no longer sold and can only be obtained by trading with another player. It was a Robux house, so it cannot be sold for Bucks.

name: Estate
summary: Estate is a two-floor, six-room Adopt Me house with four trees and a central door. You buy it for 972 Bucks through the Change Home menu.
description:
The Estate costs 972 Bucks and is bought through the Change Home menu. A release date has not been found. It is listed as available, and no removal has been noted.

Four trees and two bushes grow outside, and the door is in the middle. There are windows on the bottom, the top and the attic. The house has two floors and six rooms. The ground floor has three rooms, a staircase, and a dining room that leads to the kitchen. Upstairs there is a bedroom with a bed and a crib, plus a bathroom.
tradingNotes: It is still listed as a Bucks purchase, so you can also get it from the shop instead of trading.

name: Expandable Dino House
summary: Expandable Dino House came with the Fossil Isle Returns Bundle in May 2024. It starts with one floor and has four expansions. It is no longer sold.
description:
The Expandable Dino House came with the Fossil Isle Returns Bundle, released on May 3, 2024 during Fossil Isle Excavation. The bundle also included the Legendary Prehistoric Car. The bundle was part of Adopt Me's final-chance Robux sale on April 24, 2026 and is no longer sold. You can only get it by trading with another player.

The base home has one floor. The four expansions are Side Extension, Pool Extension, Second Floor and Sunken Basement. With the second floor and the basement added, the house can reach three levels. No details about its outside look have been found.
tradingNotes: It was bought with Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it by trading.

name: Expandable Friendly Home
summary: Expandable Friendly Home is a one-level Adopt Me house with a chimney and a fireplace lounge. It costs 675 Bucks and can grow with expansions.
description:
The Expandable Friendly Home was added in the Expandable Houses update in August 2023. You buy it with 675 Bucks through the Change Home menu, and the expansions are bought separately. A Friendly furniture pack came out in the same update.

Outside there is a chimney, a black roof, a driveway and trees. The lounge has a TV and a fireplace, and the default floors are gray with beige walls. The base house has one level and four rooms. Expansions add a second floor (6 rooms), a basement (4), a rear (3) and a side (4). You can add or remove them anytime.
tradingNotes: It is still listed as a Bucks purchase, so you can also get it from the shop instead of trading.

name: Expandable Hillside Mansion
summary: Expandable Hillside Mansion is an Adopt Me house that starts on one floor and grows to eight rooms. It costs 1,500 Bucks, with expansions sold separately.
description:
The Expandable Hillside Mansion came with the Expandable Houses update in August 2023. You buy it with 1,500 Bucks through the Change Home menu, and the expansions cost extra. A Hillside furniture pack was added in the same update.

The base house has one floor. Fully expanded, it has two stories plus a basement, and eight rooms. At that size you get ten windows, two doors, a staircase and three trees. The exterior paint and the staircase can be recolored. One of the expansions adds a pool in the basement.
tradingNotes: It is still listed as a Bucks purchase, so you can also get it from the shop instead of trading.

name: Expandable Luxury Mansion
summary: Expandable Luxury Mansion is a Robux house from the 2023 Expandable Houses update. It has a pool, a cinema room and four expansions.
description:
The Expandable Luxury Mansion is one of three expandable homes added in 2023. You buy it with Robux, not Bucks. Reports differ on the exact release day in August 2023, and it can also be obtained by trading. It appears to still be available, but that is not confirmed in game.

It starts with one floor. The expansions add a pool on the main floor and a cinema room. They also add two rooms on the second floor, one east and one west, and a basement. There are four purchasable expansions in all, and the exterior is customizable.
tradingNotes: It was bought with Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it by trading.

name: Fairy House
summary: Fairy House is a mushroom-shaped Adopt Me house added in the May 2019 Fairy Update. It has three rooms and costs 1,100 Bucks in the house shop.
description:
The Fairy House came with the Fairy Update on May 31, 2019. You buy it with 1,100 Bucks in the house shop. Nothing says it was ever retired, though current availability is worth checking in game.

The house is shaped like a mushroom. The cap takes the color you choose, and leaves and red flowers grow around the stem. Inside there are three rooms, one on the first floor and two on the second. The Fairy Update is where it was added.
tradingNotes: No trading rules for this house have been found.

name: Fairytale Castle
summary: Fairytale Castle is a four-story Adopt Me house from September 4, 2026. It costs 8,000 Bucks, and ten castle furniture pieces are sold separately.
description:
The Fairytale Castle came out in the Fairytale Castle update on September 4, 2026. You buy it with Bucks for 8,000 Bucks. It is a four-story house. The update also added ten matching castle furniture pieces. They are sold separately, and one of each adds up to 832 Bucks.

The castle has towers with pink roofs and gold trim, topped with orange flags. Green vines climb the towers, and a wide white staircase leads up to the door.
tradingNotes: No special trading rules for this house were found. Nothing says it is limited, but check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Family Home
summary: The Family Home is a two-floor Adopt Me house from 2018. Buy it for 489 Bucks or get it with the Starter Pack. See the rooms and outside details.
description:
The Family Home is one of the first five houses in Adopt Me, along with the Tiny Home, Estate, Mansion and Party House. It came out in 2018. You can buy it for 489 Bucks. It also comes with the Starter Pack, which is a Robux gamepass. It is the only house you can get both ways.

It has two floors and five rooms. The kitchen, bathroom and main room are downstairs. The bedroom items are upstairs. Outside you will see a chimney, a roof window and a small side window. It is one of the smallest houses, and it has no parties. The Estate is the larger version.
tradingNotes: You can buy it with Bucks, so it is a normal Bucks house. It is not the default starter house. That one is the Tiny Home.

name: Futuristic House
summary: The Futuristic House costs 2,500 Bucks in Adopt Me. It has two floors, an indoor pool and a balcony. You can also get it by trading with players.
description:
Buy the Futuristic House with Bucks. It costs 2,500. You can also get it by trading with another player. It comes with free furniture inside, like lamps, couches, a TV, beds and cribs.

The house has two floors and five rooms. Those are two bedrooms, a bathroom, a kitchen and a living room. There is an indoor pool to the right of the entrance. A balcony with clear railings sits above the front door. Outside, a wooden shelter for vehicles has lights and vines. You cannot change the color of the outside.
tradingNotes: It is bought with Bucks and is not marked as removed from the shop. It can also be picked up in a trade.

name: Gingerbread House
summary: The Gingerbread House is a two-floor Adopt Me house from the 2019 Christmas update. It costs 1,850 Bucks and you can change its outside color.
description:
The Gingerbread House was added in the 2019 Christmas update, in December 2019. You buy it with Bucks in the house shop. The price is 1,850 Bucks. It has two floors, so there is room to move around inside.

Inside you will find one kitchen, one bathroom, two bedrooms and an entrance area. The inside nearly matches the Modern Mansion. You can change the color of the outside. The layout does not change with it. You pick the outside color, and the rooms stay the same. It has a kitchen and a bathroom, so the basics are covered.
tradingNotes: It was a Christmas update house, and it is sold for Bucks. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Halloween Hotel
summary: The Halloween Hotel came out on September 26, 2025. It has three levels and costs 7,000 Bucks in the Adopt Me house shop.
description:
Released September 26, 2025, the Halloween Hotel came with that year's Halloween update. You can buy it in the house shop for 7,000 Bucks. You can also get it by trading.

It has three levels: a ground floor, a second floor and a basement. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a lobby, a front desk and two elevators. Only the second elevator works. The second floor has a hallway with three rooms you can enter. Each has a different bathroom. Some areas are boarded off. The basement has a main room, a smaller room and a sealed door. The brick outside has green wings, a dark green roof, a chimney and spider webbing. You can change the brick color.
tradingNotes: It can be bought with Bucks or obtained through trading. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Haunted House
summary: The Haunted House is a mahogany-colored Adopt Me mansion with two floors and thirteen rooms. Buy it for 1,950 Bucks or get it by trading.
description:
Look for the Haunted House in the Home shop. It costs 1,950 Bucks. It was added on October 12, 2023, in the second week of the 2023 Halloween event. You can also get it by trading.

This is a mahogany-colored mansion with two floors. There are thirteen rooms, six on the first floor and seven on the second. Outside, it has entrance steps and spikes along the roofline. Three windows glow purple. The other windows are boarded up or dark. You can change the wall color. The inside looks like the Cozy Cabin.
tradingNotes: Nothing marks it as limited or removed. It is sold for Bucks, and you can also get it in a trade. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Hollywood House
summary: The Hollywood House is a three-floor Adopt Me house with a theater and a red carpet entrance. Buy it with Bucks for 4,500.
description:
If you want a house with its own theater, the Hollywood House has one. You buy it with Bucks, and it costs 4,500 Bucks. It has three floors.

Outside, a red carpet runs all the way to the door, and four trees stand nearby. There is also a billboard-style sign out front, and you can customize it. Inside there are four large rooms and a theater with seating.
tradingNotes: It is sold for Bucks and is not marked as removed from the shop. No special trade rule for this house was found.

name: Hospital Home
summary: Hospital Home came with the School and Hospital Homes pass in May 2023. It is no longer sold and can only be traded for.
description:
The Hospital Home came from the School and Hospital Homes gamepass, which covered both houses with one purchase. It arrived in the Hospital and School Refresh update on May 18, 2023. The bundle was part of Adopt Me's final-chance Robux sale on April 24, 2026 and is no longer sold. You can only get it by trading with another player.

The update also brought a set of hospital furniture, including beds, reception desks and cribs. The Schoolhouse Home came in the same pass.
tradingNotes: It was bought with Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it in a trade.

name: Ice Cream House
summary: The Ice Cream House has two floors, an ice cream bar and a yellow, brown and pink outside. It came out on February 28, 2025 for 2,150 Bucks.
description:
The Ice Cream House was released on February 28, 2025. You buy it in the Home shop for 2,150 Bucks, or you can get it by trading.

The outside is yellow, brown and pink. The top has ice cream scoops, cherries and sprinkles. Two clouds and some ice cream bars sit beside it. You can recolor the pink parts, except the ground mounds, which stay pink. Floor 1 has a big dining area and an ice cream bar with three rooms behind it. Floor 2 has another dining area with a room at each end. Ice cream furniture items include a Cone Vender, a Cup Vender and a Cherry Topping.
tradingNotes: Nothing marks it as limited or retired. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Igloo Home
summary: The Igloo Home is a one-floor Adopt Me house with nine rooms. It was added in the Winter Event 2022 and costs 2,999 Bucks.
description:
Added on December 15, 2022, the Igloo Home was part of week 3 of the Winter Event. It costs 2,999 Bucks in the Home shop. You can also get it by trading. It has one floor.

It is a round, light-blue dome made with darker bricks. Snow sits on top, and the small entrance is built from large blue bricks. Outside there is a small green tree, some snowballs and snowmen. Inside, it has nine rooms.
tradingNotes: Nothing marks it as limited or retired. It is a Bucks house that can also be traded. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Korean House
summary: The Korean House has nine rooms and a red-carpet staircase to its front door. It came out on February 15, 2024 and costs 2,200 Bucks.
description:
The Korean House arrived on February 15, 2024, in week 2 of the Lunar New Year Event. You can buy it in the Home shop for 2,200 Bucks, or get it by trading.

It is inspired by traditional Korean buildings. The outside is grey, orange, red and beige. It has four bright windows and two trees on each side. A staircase with a bright red carpet leads to a brown front door. You can change the roof color. The outside looks like two stories, but the inside has nine rooms. Reports differ on how to count its floors.
tradingNotes: Nothing marks it as limited or retired. It is sold for Bucks and can also be traded. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Lunar House
summary: The Lunar House is a red Adopt Me house with a gold-trimmed yellow roof and red lanterns. It came with Lunar New Year 2021 and costs 2,000 Bucks.
description:
The Lunar House came with the Lunar New Year update in 2021. It costs 2,000 Bucks in Adopt Me. You can also get it by trading. That same update added Lunar New Year furniture, but the specific items are not known. It is a Bucks house, so you do not need Robux to get it.

The outside is red with a yellow roof trimmed in gold. The windows glow warm and have red patterns on them. Several red lanterns hang from the balcony. The floor count and the room layout for this house are not known, so neither is listed here.
tradingNotes: Nothing marks it as limited or retired. It can be bought with Bucks or traded for. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Luxury Apartments
summary: Luxury Apartments is the largest house in Adopt Me, with 22 rooms and a balcony on every floor. You buy it with Bucks for 8,000.
description:
Luxury Apartments is described as the largest house in Adopt Me. You buy it with Bucks, and it costs 8,000 Bucks. No release date was found for it.

It has 22 rooms, and every floor has its own balcony. The number of floors is not known, so check the house in game to count them.
tradingNotes: It is sold for Bucks and is not marked as removed from the shop. No special trade rule for this house was found.

name: Mansion
summary: The Mansion is a retired Adopt Me house with seven rooms, removed June 8, 2024. You can only get it by trading with another player.
description:
You cannot buy the Mansion anymore. It was removed from the game on June 8, 2024, after the Last Chance House Sale. Now the only way to get it is by trading with another player. It is an upgraded version of the Estate.

Outside, there is a front garden with bushes and small trees. The roof is black, and the front has many windows. Inside there are seven rooms. They are two bedrooms, a bathroom, a kitchen, a living room and one large room with no decorations. Reports differ on how many floors it has.
tradingNotes: The Mansion is trade-only now. It is no longer sold, and it can only be obtained by trading with another player.

name: Mermaid Mansion
summary: The Mermaid Mansion was a limited Robux house, removed June 14, 2024. It has four rooms and a central pool, and is now trade-only.
description:
The Mermaid Mansion started as a limited Robux purchase. It was the last house in the Last Chance House Sale and was removed on June 14, 2024. It is no longer sold. You can only get it by trading with another player.

A bubble surrounds the house. Clams with pearls sit outside, and the shell color follows your house color. Inside there are four rooms around a central pool. Sea-themed furniture is included with the house. The number of floors is not known. Because the shell color follows the house color, changing your house color changes the shells too. There are four rooms in total.
tradingNotes: It is trade-only. Because it was bought with Robux, it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it in a trade.

name: Millionaire Mansion
summary: The Millionaire Mansion comes in the Millionaire Pack gamepass with a Luxury Car. It has three floors, a driveway and spotlights.
description:
You get the Millionaire Mansion from the Millionaire Pack gamepass, which is bought with Robux. The pack also includes a Luxury Car. The house has three floors. Reports on the current price differ, so check the pass page for it. It is not sold with Bucks.

There is a driveway for parking vehicles. Spotlights sit on top of the house. A couple of trees grow near the top, and five more stand on the ground. The Luxury Car that comes in the pack is bundled with the house. The Luxury Car cannot be traded.
tradingNotes: It came from Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it in a trade. The Luxury Car in the pack cannot be traded.

name: Modern Mansion
summary: Modern Mansion is a two-floor Adopt Me house with seven rooms and an indoor pool room. It is no longer sold and can only be traded for.
description:
The Modern Mansion was a Robux house, sold through a gamepass. It was part of Adopt Me's final-chance Robux sale on April 24, 2026 and is no longer sold. You can only get it by trading with another player. It has two floors.

There are seven rooms, including bathrooms, with a side doorway. The indoor pool room sits in front of the main doorway. Outside, four trees stand by the mailbox. Three planters with trees sit on the roof.
tradingNotes: It was bought with Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it in a trade.

name: Monster Mansion
summary: Monster Mansion is a four-level haunted Adopt Me house from September 25, 2026. It costs 13,000 Bucks, and its furniture is sold separately.
description:
The Monster Mansion came out in the Monster Mansion update on September 25, 2026. You buy it with Bucks for 13,000 Bucks, or get it by trading. No furniture comes with it. Ten matching pieces are sold separately, and one of each adds up to 3,413 Bucks.

It is a haunted house with a purple roof and glowing green windows that look like eyes. Parts of the outside are animated, and a gap of broken planks works as a mouth. Dark metal fencing surrounds a grassy yard with a dirt path, and a glowing green lantern sits in the yard. Inside there are four levels. A hallway leads from the entrance to three rooms, with the stairs on the right. The kitchen is on the left, and a laundry room beyond it has a hatch down to the basement. The living room is on the right, next to an empty back room.
tradingNotes: You can also get it by trading. No special trading rules for this house were found.

name: Moon House
summary: The Moon House is a one-floor Adopt Me house with a low gravity button and a portal. It came out May 9, 2025 and costs 4,000 Bucks.
description:
The Moon House was released on May 9, 2025. You can buy it with Bucks for 4000, or get it by trading.

Outside, light-gray rocky ground is ringed by caution tape, with a small sign nearby. A large dark-gray portal frame has stairs up to a portal. You can change the portal color. Asteroids and three colored planets float around. Inside is one room of dark-gray rocky terrain with the same portal. A red button near the portal turns low gravity on and off. Items from the Moon furniture pack decorate the house.
tradingNotes: Nothing marks it as limited or retired. Check in game to see if it is still for sale.

name: Mountain House
summary: The Mountain House has a multi-level mountain inside, with a large bridge and working lifts. It was added February 23, 2023 for 3,000 Bucks.
description:
Added on February 23, 2023, the Mountain House costs 3,000 Bucks. You can also get it by trading. Castle-themed house decor came out at the same time. Reports differ on its floor count, so no number is given here.

The inside is a mountain with many levels. A large bridge crosses it, and there are working lifts that go between the levels. No room count is known, so none is given.
tradingNotes: It is sold for Bucks and is not marked as removed from the shop. No special trade rule for this house was found.

name: Party House
summary: Party House in Adopt Me costs 3,575 Bucks. It has 2 floors with a kitchen, one bedroom and one bathroom, and a heavily decorated outside.
description:
You can buy the Party House with Bucks. It costs 3,575 Bucks. It is one of the first houses added to Adopt Me, though the exact release date is not known.

The outside is heavily decorated, and there are lights on the deck. Inside, you get 2 floors. There is a kitchen, one bathroom and one bedroom. The floors come empty, so you start with no furniture at all and add your own.
tradingNotes: You buy this one with Bucks. It comes with no furniture, since the floors come empty.

name: Pirate Ship House
summary: Pirate Ship House came in the April 2020 Pirate Update. It was sold for 1,600 Bucks until June 12, 2024, and now it is trade-only.
description:
Pirate Ship House arrived in April 2020 with the Pirate Update. It used to cost 1,600 Bucks in the Build House menu. It was taken off sale on June 12, 2024, so now you can only get it by trading with another player.

The outside looks like a ship. It has a blue hull, brown wood and two white sails. One sail can show your Roblox avatar head. Reports also mention two palm trees outside. Inside, the main living room has a staircase up to a second-floor hallway with several rooms. Some pirate furniture comes free with the house.
tradingNotes: This house is no longer sold. It can only be obtained by trading with another player. Furniture inside goes with the house but has no Bucks value on resale.

name: Pizza Place
summary: Pizza Place is a restaurant-style Adopt Me house from the Own a Shop update. It costs 500 Bucks and has 2 floors and a pizza kitchen.
description:
Looking for a house that works like a restaurant? Pizza Place was introduced in the Own a Shop update. You buy it with Bucks, and it costs 500 Bucks.

It has 2 floors. Inside you will find a kitchen with pizza-making counters, a bathroom and two extra rooms. Outside there is an awning, a wooden bench, a bay window and two small trees by the door. A small circle over the door shows your Roblox avatar face, and only the Pirate Ship House shares that. You can change the outside color, which comes with white accents.
tradingNotes: You buy this one with Bucks. Its default interior has a register, booth, table, crates and kitchen gear.

name: Queenslander House
summary: Queenslander House arrived in the January 11, 2024 Adopt Me update. You can buy it for 1,650 Bucks or get it through house trading.
description:
The Queenslander House is from the Adopt Me update of January 11, 2024. It costs 1,650 Bucks. You can also get it through house trading.

The layout is open-concept, with plenty of natural light. A matching Queenslander furniture pack came out at the same time, with items priced from 8 to 225 Bucks. Reports differ on how many rooms the house has, so it is worth a look in game.
tradingNotes: Last time it was checked, this house was still sold for Bucks and had not been removed. You can also get it by trading.

name: Racetrack House
summary: Racetrack House was added in August 2023 and costs 2,200 Bucks. It has a tire-shaped arch outside and a wide green space with a track inside.
description:
Racetrack House was added in August 2023. You buy it with Bucks for 2,200 Bucks, or get it through house trading. Premade raceways are separate purchases.

Outside, a large black tire-shaped arch with blue edges frames a glowing yellow entrance. There is a track with checkered flags and three small go-karts. Your house color changes the tunnel under the arch. Inside is a wide green space with trees and mountains, and vehicles can be driven in there. The premade raceways are Simple at 1,900 Bucks, Skillful at 2,100 Bucks and Complex at 2,700 Bucks.
tradingNotes: You buy this one with Bucks, and it was not listed as removed when last checked. The raceways are sold on their own and do not come with the house.

name: Royal Palace
summary: Royal Palace is a 2-floor Adopt Me house from August 2022. It costs 2,750 Bucks and has five rounded towers and paw-print flags on the roof.
description:
Royal Palace came out in August 2022. It costs 2,750 Bucks, and you can also get it through house trading.

The house has 2 floors. A front porch sits up three steps, with double rounded doors. Above it is a triangular gable with a golden half-circle detail, and an upper balcony with circular-framed doors and windows. The roof has five rounded towers and three flying paw-print flags. Two pillars and small potted trees stand by the front. Only a Bucks price is listed for this house, and no furniture set is listed with it.
tradingNotes: This house is sold for Bucks and was not listed as removed when last checked.

name: Ruler's Castle
summary: Ruler's Castle was sold for 6,899 Bucks until June 11, 2024. It has 2 floors and nine rooms, and now it is only available by trading.
description:
Ruler's Castle used to be sold for 6,899 Bucks. It was removed from sale on June 11, 2024. Today it is no longer sold, and you can only get it by trading with another player.

The house has 2 floors and nine rooms. There are four bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom, a dining room and a throne room. The inside is mostly furnished. The outside is lightly decorated, with a white pearl on top, similar to Sky Castle. Players can stand on the pearl. A smaller related house called the Castle also exists.
tradingNotes: This house is trade-only now. Furniture inside goes with it but has no Bucks value.

name: Safari Home
summary: Safari Home came out on July 20, 2023 during the Safari Zone event. It costs 2,100 Bucks and is a tower built on wooden log supports.
description:
Safari Home was released on July 20, 2023, in week 2 of the Safari Zone event. You can buy it with Bucks for 2,100 Bucks, or get it by trading. Safari-themed furniture came out with it.

The house is a tower on wooden log supports. The walls and floors are beige. Fences and bushes surround it, and the entrance has a stone frame. The first-floor windows are round. On the second floor there is a fireplace with animated smoke. Wooden ladders connect the floors. The furniture prices are not listed.
tradingNotes: Nothing says whether this house has been retired or has returned, so check current availability in game. You can also get it by trading.

name: Sandbox Island
summary: Sandbox Island is the largest Adopt Me house, an island-style beach space with a stone portal. It was released in February 2022.
description:
Sandbox Island was released in February 2022, alongside the Taxi Bundle gamepass. You buy it with Bucks, or get it through house trading.

This is an island-style space, not an indoor house, and it is currently the largest house. A gray stone portal flanked by three palm trees, with a yellow glow, leads to the beach. The inside has a large beach with water, palm trees and wooden steps. It is the only house where vehicles can be spawned inside, but vehicles cannot pass through the portal. Racetrack custom tracks can be built here.
tradingNotes: Reports differ on the Bucks price, so check it in game. It was not listed as removed when last checked.

name: Scary House
summary: Scary House was the first Halloween-themed Adopt Me house, added November 11, 2021. It costs 1,800 Bucks and has 4 levels.
description:
As the first Halloween-themed house in Adopt Me, Scary House arrived on November 11, 2021, during the Halloween Event. It costs 1,800 Bucks. You can also get it by trading.

It has 4 levels: a basement, a ground floor, a first floor and a small attic. A short hallway on the ground floor leads to worn stairs. Outside you will see wooden panels, three glowing windows with a glow you can recolor, three tall trees at the back, a small raven on the front porch and two hanging lanterns. There are four rooms, not counting the large main areas.
tradingNotes: Nothing says this house is limited or retired, but current availability should be checked in game. It can be obtained by trading.

name: Schoolhouse Home
summary: Schoolhouse Home came with the School and Hospital Homes pass in May 2023. It is no longer sold and can only be traded for.
description:
The Schoolhouse Home came with the Hospital and School Refresh update on May 18, 2023. It was sold through the School and Hospital Homes gamepass, one pass for both homes. The bundle was part of Adopt Me's final-chance Robux sale on April 24, 2026 and is no longer sold. You can only get it by trading with another player.

The house is listed with 1 floor. School-themed furniture came with the update, including desks, bookshelves and a blackboard. The Hospital Home came in the same pass.
tradingNotes: You got this house with Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks, even if you got it by trading.

name: Shop House
summary: Shop House is an Adopt Me house with 4 rooms set up as a shop. It costs 1,750 Bucks and has a logo you can swap to any item icon.
description:
Shop House is bought with Bucks for 1,750 Bucks. You can also get it through house trading. No release date is on record.

It has 4 rooms and is set up as a shop. The building logo can be swapped to any item icon in your inventory. Only the Hollywood House has a similar customizable sign. Outside, two small trees stand by the door and a bench sits in front of the window. Floors are not stated for this house, and no furniture is listed with it.
tradingNotes: This house is sold for Bucks and was not listed as removed when last checked.

name: Soccer Stadium
summary: Soccer Stadium is an Adopt Me house from the July 2024 Soccer update, with 2 floors and 7 rooms. It is no longer sold and can only be traded for.
description:
Soccer Stadium was added in the Soccer update in July 2024 and was sold for Robux. It was part of Adopt Me's final-chance Robux sale on April 24, 2026 and is no longer sold. You can only get it by trading with another player.

The outside has blue walls and glowing blue windows around a central pitch. A white rim holds red, green, yellow and blue flags, and you can change the wall color. There are 2 floors and 7 rooms. Six are on the first floor, linked by 2 hallways, and one hallway has 2 small bathrooms. The last room is on the second floor and looks over the pitch and stadium.
tradingNotes: It was bought with Robux, so it cannot be sold for Bucks.

name: Space Fleet House
summary: Space Fleet House was released June 30, 2022. It has 3 floors and comes from the Space Bundle gamepass, which costs 1,060 Robux.
description:
Space Fleet House was released on June 30, 2022. It is sold through the Space Bundle gamepass for 1,060 Robux. The bundle also includes the Capricorn legendary pet. No Bucks price is listed for the house.

The house has 3 floors. There is an anti-gravity button on the second floor that makes players jump very high. The house color option changes the first-floor edges, the second floor and the walls around the second-floor window.
tradingNotes: It is a gamepass house, so it cannot be sold for Bucks. You can also get it by trading. Check in game that the bundle is still on sale.

name: Tiny Home
summary: Tiny Home is the free starting house in Adopt Me, one of the original five from around July 2018. Extra copies cost 240 Bucks.
description:
Every new player gets the Tiny Home for free. It is one of the original five houses, from around July 2018. You can buy extra copies for 240 Bucks, or get them by trading.

It is the smallest and cheapest house. Inside there are 3 rooms: a main room, a small bedroom and a small bathroom. Outside you will see one door, a chimney and a window beside the door. The main room and the bedroom each have 2 windows. You cannot hold parties here. The house was enlarged after the Friendship Bar update.
tradingNotes: Tiny Home is the free starting house, so a player who only owns it needs a second house before they can trade it. Extra copies can be bought for 240 Bucks.

name: Toyshop House
summary: Toyshop House came in the September 2023 Aviator Kiwi and Toy Shop update. It has 2 floors and 9 rooms, and you buy it with Robux.
description:
Toyshop House came in the Aviator Kiwi and Toy Shop update in September 2023. You buy it with Robux, or get it by trading. The Kiwi, Red Scarf and a toyshop furniture set came out at the same time.

The house has 2 floors and 9 rooms. Six are on the first floor, joined by a narrow hallway. Three are on the second floor, joined by a small balcony. The walls are brown and peach with red and blue accents, including the roof. The windows are curved and yellow. Two small red gifts with glowing yellow bows sit outside.
tradingNotes: It is bought with Robux, so it cannot be resold for Bucks. Reports differ on the Robux price, so check it in game.

name: Treehouse Update
summary: Treehouse Update is a 1-floor Adopt Me house set between two trees. It costs 800 Bucks and has a staircase that wraps around the trees.
description:
The Treehouse Update house was added in the Treehouse update. You buy it from the house shop for 800 Bucks, and you can also get it by trading.

It has 1 floor and 3 rooms: a living room with a kitchen and lounge area, a bedroom and a bathroom. The house is set between two trees, with a staircase wrapping around them. You can change the outside color. It has front windows and two small roof windows. No furniture bundle is listed, only the default furnishings. You buy it from the house shop with Bucks, not Robux.
tradingNotes: This house is sold for Bucks. Its exact current availability was not independently confirmed, so check in game.
